title: Quadratic temperature trend, North America (A1B), 1860-2099
method: Extract the annual air_temperature series (240 years), fit a least-squares 2nd-order polynomial in time (numpy.polyfit), evaluate it for every year and write Year + fitted value. Reference: cos(latitude)-weighted mean over the North America grid; the unweighted domain mean is also accepted; the instruction asks for the regional mean, so a single grid point fails.
benchmark_defects: The published instruction does not say which location/aggregate to fit; the published reference script fits the first time-series slice of the cube (`next(cube.slices(['time']))`), i.e. a single grid point.
The published reference script depends on Iris and cftime, which the execution environment must provide.
checks: required: one row per year 1860-2099 (year column or date strings)

required: a numeric column equals the least-squares quadratic fit (RMSE <= 0.02 K widened by the output rounding error (0.1 K precision -> 0.039 K; coarser than 0.1 K not credited), K or degC) of some grid-point series, the unweighted domain mean or the area-weighted domain mean
required: the fitted series is a domain mean (unweighted or area-weighted), not a single grid point
